fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2015 by $45.5 million. As of December 31, 2015, we did not have any outstanding fuel derivatives.

instrument_type_details.notes: No outstanding fuel derivatives as of Dec 31, 2015. Prior year (2014) had $4.8M asset position. Last fuel derivative activity was in 2015 (options purchased in 2014 for 2015 coverage).

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed 255,008 [2015] 200,498 [2014] [from 2015 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense decreased by 24.7% from $612.9 million in 2014 to $461.4 million in 2015 due to 27.2% increase in fuel gallons consumed.
